instruction: A candid full-shot documentary photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, extending her right arm to touch the left shoulder of the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing left, looking back at her. No bystanders are present. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
